result.keyword: What's the best payment processor for a small online store?
result.markdown:
For a small online store, my recommendation would be **Stripe or Shopify Payments**, depending on which ecommerce platform you're using.

If you're operating in Australia, I'd shortlist four providers: Stripe, Shopify Payments, PayPal and Airwallex.

## Best payment processors compared

![Vagus Nerve Certification | MindMax Academy](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/aXMVm1C0IZ2sYL1Cc-pnLa0-TAY84r1ttAkC3L-BonUW-0ZWt4YgfYxZJFNFO507YDw7sEw0_m36oWUAFe9k5k5U7mabcFJnFcYfX_JEQIwvZxSSTzYlrpiE9fNs0cFfLq2VqBOGktLoGahF64GIPKHvKbJJ1Jz0L_56eTNx-TPu4D5oHHq8-DAX5xxs05i8?purpose=fullsize)

**1\. Stripe**

(Best all-rounder)

- Easy integration with most ecommerce platforms.
- Supports cards, Apple Pay and Google Pay.
- Good fraud prevention, reporting and recurring payments.
- Australian domestic cards: approximately 1.7% + A\$0.30.
  
  [Stripe Australia](https://stripe.com/au)

---

![Shopify Payments w Polsce – jak działa, koszty, wdrożenie, zalety - Adtrip](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/tzlxg0Y9z5dRoMa7puRQ5gUF-G3hcQ7FEcuVco38BEG917LKXepufVl9cw-FwTKDdqoHqkcHNs202c43Bsg-KXxlvnrYPNEJMBSIYJqLREQ2DlgIvAOQgkKyUCOU_zdRd59gIwC2e-5cs0YCLvv_6mYa-9FiK4qFkvvkawoheALPlNv3AkWQkvUMElw-UVk8?purpose=fullsize)

**2\. Shopify Payments**

(Best for Shopify stores)

- Built directly into Shopify.
- Simple checkout and payment management.
- No separate third-party gateway needed.
- Australian domestic card rates depend on your Shopify plan.
  
  [Shopify Payments Australia](https://www.shopify.com/au/payments)

---

![Download the PayPal logo in PNG y SVG | LogosDown](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/MAzkiJ1YuDnyj2FyYAyszlEHA_k7S0XqFuDRhbVDc0cICTj1-X82VJgt7N8vcRcKsONlo3HvF0Pe2MUizAJnEXGjXwhkQKSdT9w8dASkeKU2hONBc_K0UGh46cKL9ey1QEsmTJtnMOjwtp9k8flMfotUdye-2o09Vcb_X37Fr_RqbfMx2vNQ-Z2QRLli3zQI?purpose=fullsize)

**3\. PayPal**

- Recognisable and trusted by many shoppers.
- Offers an additional checkout option.
- Easy to integrate.
- Can be more expensive than other providers.
  
  [PayPal Australia Business](https://www.paypal.com/au/business)

---

![Airwallex | PrimaryMarkets](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/KlzNRy1itFhhCNEN_L0KvNWkPYoYwUg75JWplGXIU35h8pDTK_JKLGEhovfk78U5ax71kBL13mrDZR8Pcmh84u5DVtqFBr1L6KWjajY-dQneJVPEV1MxIhaz51bjCGCPhQ6nqEFXybZ-cEDxkVpG61bz619CHHqu0ckd34n_iLMkOzHoYnesl1t30sL9NbWb?purpose=fullsize)

**4\. Airwallex**

- Competitive domestic card processing fees.
- Particularly useful for international sales.
- Multi-currency accounts and settlements.
- Good option as your business grows.
  
  [Airwallex Australia](https://www.airwallex.com/au)

Australian fee comparisons are based on published 2026 pricing; confirm your actual rate, including international-card and currency-conversion charges. [www.airwallex.com](https://www.airwallex.com/en-au/blog/ecommerce-payment-solutions-providers?utm_source=chatgpt.com)[www.airwallex.com](https://www.airwallex.com/en-au/blog/compare-payment-systems-for-small-businesses?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

## My recommendation

For a new or small Australian online store\:

- **Shopify store\:** Shopify Payments + PayPal as an additional checkout option.
- **WooCommerce store\:** Stripe + PayPal.
- **Selling internationally\:** Consider Airwallex alongside Stripe.
- **Want the simplest setup\:** Stripe is an excellent starting point.

I wouldn't overcomplicate things initially. Reliable checkout, reasonable fees and easy refunds are more important than having lots of payment providers.
